title: Estimating statistical power and sample size

cues.en: Mike: Now that you have an idea, a conceptual idea of what statistical power is and how to interpret it, I am now going to show you
cues.zh: Mike：現在你對統計檢定力與解讀方式，已經有概念，接著示範

cues.en: one of the many formulas for computing statistical power.
cues.zh: 許多檢定力公式中的一個。

cues.en: And that will also lead us to a discussion of how to compute the sample size based on a desired power.
cues.zh: 也會帶出，如何根據期望檢定力計算樣本數。

cues.en: Now I'd like to give you a clear warning before watching the rest of this video.
cues.zh: 繼續看之前，先明確提醒。

cues.en: And that warning is that the method that I'm going to show you here, the formula that I will show you for estimating statistical power
cues.zh: 這項提醒是：這裡我要展示的方法，也就是估計統計檢定力的公式，

cues.en: is the simplest, most basic, essential calculation, or formula, that is possible.
cues.zh: 是最簡單、最基本、最核心的計算方式。

cues.en: It's just based on a really simple z-statistic or something you could convert from a t-statistic.
cues.zh: 只根據很簡單的 Z 統計量，或從 t 統計量轉換而來。

cues.en: In the next video, I'm going to show you a much better way using a tool that's like really well-developed and highly regarded in the field for actually computing
cues.zh: 下一支會展示更好的方式，使用開發成熟、領域內評價很高的工具，來計算

cues.en: or estimating statistical power and sample size.
cues.zh: 或估計檢定力與樣本數。

cues.en: But the reason why I'm showing you this simple formula in this video is because I want you to get the intuition, I want you to really get the feeling
cues.zh: 這裡展示簡單公式，是希望你建立直覺，真正感受

cues.en: for the relationships between statistical power, effect size, variance, and sample size.
cues.zh: 檢定力、效果量、變異數與樣本數的關係。

cues.en: And I think focusing on this simple formula is really going to hammer that into your brain.
cues.zh: 聚焦簡單公式，能讓概念深刻記在腦中。

cues.en: Just keep in mind that in practice, when you are really sitting down to compute statistical power, I don't actually recommend the method that I'm going to show you because I think it's a little bit overly simplistic.
cues.zh: 記住，實際計算檢定力時，我其實不推薦這個方法，因為有點過度簡化。

cues.en: All right, so with that warning out of the way, here is a formula for calculating power, simple formula.
cues.zh: 提醒過了，這是計算檢定力的簡單公式。

cues.en: So we have this z character, which is not formally a z, like a standard deviation value, which is why I put a little dash through it.
cues.zh: 這個 Z 字元，不是正式代表標準差值的 Z，所以我加一小橫線。

cues.en: So it's equal to the numerator, which is basically the effect size.
cues.zh: 它等於分子，基本上是效果量。

cues.en: It's the mean of the sample divided by the population null hypothesis value.
cues.zh: 樣本平均值除以母體虛無假設值。

cues.en: And that's divided by the standard error, basically.
cues.zh: 再除以基本上就是標準誤的量。

cues.en: So the standard deviation divided by square root of n.
cues.zh: 也就是標準差除以 N 的平方根。

cues.en: So here's what all those things mean.
cues.zh: 這裡說明各項。

cues.en: Now, we can rewrite this equation like this.
cues.zh: 可以改寫成這樣。

cues.en: So all I'm doing is just bringing this square root of n up into the numerator.
cues.zh: 只是把 N 的平方根移到分子。

cues.en: And I think that helps highlight the relationship between statistical power and, well, this is not exactly statistical power, but the higher this is, the higher the power is gonna be.
cues.zh: 這有助凸顯檢定力的關係，雖然不完全就是檢定力，但這個值愈高，檢定力也愈高。

cues.en: So this is proportional to statistical power.
cues.zh: 所以與檢定力成比例。

cues.en: So the relationship between statistical power, the effect size, the sample size, and the variability in the data, so the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 呈現檢定力、效果量、樣本數，以及資料變異，也就是標準差的關係。

cues.en: So when the effect size gets larger or when n gets larger, although this is not a linear relationship, this is gonna be a square root relationship,
cues.zh: 效果量變大，或 N 變大，雖然不是線性而是平方根關係，

cues.en: then statistical power is going to increase.
cues.zh: 檢定力都會增加。

cues.en: And when the variability gets smaller, then the statistical power will also increase.
cues.zh: 變異較小，檢定力也會增加。

cues.en: Okay, so what do you do with this z-value once you've computed it?
cues.zh: 算出 Z 值之後，怎麼用？

cues.en: Well, what you wanna do is look for the probability that a z distribution is greater than that z-value.
cues.zh: 找出 Z 分布大於這個 Z 值的機率。

cues.en: So that is the probability of a standard normal distribution being greater than this observed z-value.
cues.zh: 就是標準常態分布大於觀察 Z 值的機率。

cues.en: And that is exactly equal to 1 minus beta, the statistical power.
cues.zh: 它正好等於 1 減 beta，也就是檢定力。

cues.en: So let me show you what this looks like on a graph.
cues.zh: 用圖示範。

cues.en: So here I have the cumulative probability distribution of a normal probability function.
cues.zh: 這是常態機率函數的累積機率分布。

cues.en: So that's the one.
cues.zh: 就是這個。

cues.en: If we were drawing the actual probability function, that would be a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 如果畫實際機率函數，會是高斯形狀。

cues.en: And then here it's just the cumulative distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡則是累積分布。

cues.en: So every point is the sum of all the probability values to the left of that point.
cues.zh: 每個點是其左側所有機率值的總和。

cues.en: Okay, so now, once you've computed that z-value that I showed in the previous slide, you look at that z-value here.
cues.zh: 算出上一張的 Z 值後，看這裡。

cues.en: So let's imagine, I'm just making this number up, but let's imagine we got a z-value of 1.4 based on our effect size, sample size, and the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 假設依效果量、樣本數與標準差，得到 Z 值 1.4，數字是我編的。

cues.en: So we get a value of 1.4, and now we wanna know what is the mass of this probability function above this z-value.
cues.zh: 得到 1.4，要知道機率函數在這個 Z 值以上的質量。

cues.en: That's what this says.
cues.zh: 就是這裡的意思。

cues.en: And so with a cumulative density function, it's actually really easy to read off.
cues.zh: 累積密度函數很容易讀取。

cues.en: We just look at the y-axis coordinate corresponding to where the function crosses this x-axis value.
cues.zh: 只要看函數在這個 X 軸值位置，對應的 Y 軸座標。

cues.en: So that turns out to be pretty high here. So it's 0.92.
So that means that in this case, for our z of 1.4, we get a statistical power of 0.92.
cues.zh: 所以 Z 為 1.4 時，檢定力是 0.92。

cues.en: So that's good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: A power of 0.92 is pretty respectably high.
cues.zh: 0.92 是相當高的檢定力。

cues.en: So here is that formula again.
cues.zh: 再次列出公式。

cues.en: And now what's interesting about math is that we can solve for different quantities inside an equation, which is pretty neat.
cues.zh: 數學有趣之處，是可以解出方程式中的不同量。

cues.en: So before, we were assuming that we knew all of these quantities and we are solving for this, but let's say we know this value, we know z,
cues.zh: 先前假設知道這些量，求這一項；現在假設知道 Z，

cues.en: and we wanna solve for any of these other things, like, for example, n, the sample size.
cues.zh: 想解出其他量，例如樣本數 N。

cues.en: So here's a great opportunity for you to practice your algebra skills.
cues.zh: 是練習代數的好機會。

cues.en: I would like you to pause the video, bust out of piece of paper and a pen, and solve this equation for n.
cues.zh: 暫停，拿紙筆，解出 N。

cues.en: So get n to be on the left-hand side of the equation.
cues.zh: 讓 N 單獨在方程式左側。

cues.en: Okay, how did it go? Did you figure it out yet?
cues.zh: 結果如何？想出來了嗎？

cues.en: So the answer turns out to be this.
cues.zh: 答案像這樣。

cues.en: And so basically, this means that for a given effect size and a given standard deviation and a given desired statistical power,
cues.zh: 基本上，給定效果量、標準差與期望檢定力，

cues.en: we can actually compute the n, the sample size that we would need in order to satisfy this equation.
cues.zh: 就能算出滿足這個方程式的所需樣本數 N。

cues.en: So already, you can start seeing some of the difficulties that I was hinting at the end of the previous video.
cues.zh: 已經開始看到，上一支影片結尾暗示的困難。

cues.en: So if you haven't yet collected your data, that's usually when you would estimate your sample size is before you actually start your research.
cues.zh: 通常在尚未收集資料、研究開始之前，估計樣本數。

cues.en: How do you know what the effect size is and how do you know what the variability is?
cues.zh: 但如何知道效果量與變異？

cues.en: Really, the only quantity in here that you can be confident about knowing is this value here, which is basically just
cues.zh: 唯一能有把握知道的，大概是這裡的值，基本上是

cues.en: the sort of inverted value of, let's say, .9 or .95 on the cumulative density function.
cues.zh: 累積密度函數中，例如 0.9 或 0.95 對應的反向求值。

cues.en: So this thing, you can't really know.
cues.zh: 這一項無法真正知道。

cues.en: You can sort of look in previous literature and guess it.
cues.zh: 可以查先前文獻來猜測。

cues.en: This thing, you can't really know, but again, you can look in previous literature and see what other people have reported.
cues.zh: 這一項也無法知道，但也能看文獻，參考其他人報告。

cues.en: But you have to keep in mind that people are not going to be reporting small samples, small effect sizes.
cues.zh: 但記住，人們不會報告小樣本、小效果量。

cues.en: So there's quite a lot of ambiguities that go into this equation.
cues.zh: 所以方程式裡有很多不確定性。

cues.en: Nonetheless, the math is actually pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 儘管如此，數學其實直接。

cues.en: So once you realize this, that you can rewrite this equation for statistical power and for sample size, then that allows you to create a chart like this,
cues.zh: 知道能為檢定力與樣本數改寫公式後，就能建立這種圖，

cues.en: where you basically compute the statistical power and the sample size for a given effect size and a given standard deviation.
cues.zh: 給定效果量與標準差，計算檢定力與樣本數。

cues.en: So with this particular pair of value, so an effect size of one and a standard deviation of 10, then we can just read off anywhere we want on this thing.
cues.zh: 這個特定設定，效果量 1、標準差 10，可以在曲線任意位置讀取。

cues.en: So if we want a statistical power of .8, we need 71 data points in our sample, under these assumptions.
cues.zh: 要檢定力 0.8，在這些假設下，需要樣本中有 71 個資料點。

cues.en: And if you want a power of .9, then you're gonna need a lot of data.
cues.zh: 要 0.9，就需要很多資料。

cues.en: It's even off the chart here.
cues.zh: 甚至超出圖表。

cues.en: Conversely, if you have a sample size of 20, then you only have a statistical power of .67 or something like that.
cues.zh: 反過來，樣本數 20，檢定力只有約 0.67。

cues.en: Now of course, this blue curve depends on these parameters.
cues.zh: 藍色曲線當然取決於參數。

cues.en: So if you would set the sigma here to be one instead of 10, then this whole curve is really getting pushed up here.
cues.zh: 如果 sigma 從 10 改成 1，整條曲線會被推高。

cues.en: It's gonna be all the way up here.
cues.zh: 會在上面。

cues.en: And then a sample size of 30 might give you a statistical power of .9 or maybe even larger than that,
cues.zh: 若 sigma 真是 1、效果量是 1，樣本數 30，可能就有 0.9，甚至更高的檢定力。

cues.en: if sigma is really one and the effect size is one.
cues.zh: 在這些條件下。

cues.en: Okay, so that all seems kind of, mathematically, it's pretty simple, it's pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 數學上似乎很簡單、直接。

cues.en: But there's two issues.
cues.zh: 但有兩個問題。

cues.en: One is basically, the stuff I said at the end of the previous lecture, which is that it's very hard to know these quantities, the variability and the effect sizes.
cues.zh: 第一，就是上一堂最後說的，很難知道變異與效果量。

cues.en: It's very hard to know them in advance.
cues.zh: 很難事先知道。

cues.en: And the second thing is that it's really not this simple.
cues.zh: 第二，實際上沒那麼簡單。

cues.en: So the formula that I just showed you here is fine.
cues.zh: 剛才公式是可以的。

cues.en: That is a real formula.
cues.zh: 是真實公式。

cues.en: There's nothing wrong with it, but it's for a really, really simplified case.
cues.zh: 沒有錯，但只適用於非常簡化的情況。

cues.en: And the true formulas, or the sort of formulas for more advanced statistical analyses get to be pretty hairy pretty quickly.
cues.zh: 更進階統計分析的真正公式，很快就變得複雜。

cues.en: But I just want you to see that the principle is the same as what I showed in this video.
cues.zh: 但希望你看到，原理與這支影片相同。

cues.en: So in practice, I definitely recommend using an online statistical power calculator, and I'm going to introduce you to one in the next video.
cues.zh: 實際上，我非常推薦線上檢定力計算器，下一支會介紹一個。

cues.en: But before getting there, there is one more thing I would like to point out, and that is the distinction between what's called a priori power and post-hoc power.
cues.zh: 之前還有一點，就是事前檢定力與事後檢定力的區別。

cues.en: So a priori means it comes before, and post-hoc means it comes after.
cues.zh: 事前表示之前，事後表示之後。

cues.en: So a priori power means you get your effect size and your standard deviation either from published literature or from pilot data.
cues.zh: 事前檢定力，是從文獻或前導資料取得效果量與標準差。

cues.en: So you might be gathering some initial samples of data to estimate statistical power to use in a larger scale study.
cues.zh: 可以先收集初步樣本，估計較大規模研究所需檢定力。

cues.en: So a priori power is used to compute sample size prospectively.
cues.zh: 事前檢定力用來前瞻計算樣本數。

cues.en: So before you actually start running your experiment, before you start collecting your data.
cues.zh: 在實驗、資料收集真正開始之前。

cues.en: A priori power is widely used, it's widely accepted.
cues.zh: 廣泛使用，也廣受接受。

cues.en: It's in basically every grant proposal.
cues.zh: 基本上每份研究計畫申請都有。

cues.en: It has to have some measure of a priori computed power.
cues.zh: 必須有某種事先計算的檢定力指標。

cues.en: But I hope I've expressed to you that a priori power is fine.
cues.zh: 希望我已經說清楚，事前檢定力很好。

cues.en: It's good to compute.
cues.zh: 值得計算。

cues.en: And I think we should be using this more often, but it's wrought with difficulties and uncertainties, and you just shouldn't have too much faith
cues.zh: 應該更常使用，但充滿困難與不確定性，不應過度相信

cues.en: in a priori power calculations or a priori sample size calculations.
cues.zh: 事前檢定力或事前樣本數計算。

cues.en: Now post-hoc power is totally different.
cues.zh: 事後檢定力則完全不同。

cues.en: That is when you compute the statistical power of your study.
cues.zh: 是計算自己研究的檢定力。

cues.en: So you've already gathered your data, you've already run all the analyses, and then you compute power on your own data, which you've already collected.
cues.zh: 已經收集資料、做完全部分析，再用已收集的資料計算檢定力。

cues.en: Now that sounds fine.
cues.zh: 聽起來沒問題。

cues.en: The issue is that it's basically just proportional to the p-value.
cues.zh: 但它基本上只是與 P 值成比例。

cues.en: So post-hoc power actually isn't really providing any new information that isn't already in the dataset you have, like the p-value and the sample size.
cues.zh: 不會提供 P 值、樣本數等現有資料之外的新資訊。

cues.en: So sometimes people ask for post post-hoc power calculations, I'm sure they mean well, but it's not actually providing anything new.
cues.zh: 有時人們要求事後檢定力，我相信出發點好，但其實沒有提供新東西。

cues.en: All right, so in this video, you learned about a formula, simplified formula for computing statistical power, and also for computing sample size.
cues.zh: 這支影片學到了計算檢定力與樣本數的一個簡化公式。
